_comment: Single source of truth for the Brush Pass pages. `npm run build` stamps these values
into every element marked data-bp / data-bp-href / data-bp-when, the same way
nerve/release.json drives the Nerve pages. Never edit a URL inside an HTML file.
signup.formUrl  — the Google Form volunteers fill in. Leave it "" until the form
exists: every sign-up button then falls back to the email route
and the pages say so. Fill it in and rebuild; nothing else changes.
play.optInUrl   — the Google Play closed-testing opt-in link. Deliberately "":
a tester has to be on the tester lists BEFORE the link works, so
publishing it here would only produce a page of 'not available'.
Fill it in on the day the app is in open testing or production.
play.listingUrl — the public Play Store listing, once the app is out of closed testing.
stage           — closed-testing | open-testing | production. Changes the badge and
the wording of what a volunteer is signing up for.
